answer_1.quote: We present RANKGEN, a large encoder which scores continuations given a prefix and can be plugged into any text generation system... We primarily focus on open‑ended text generation, evaluating on Wikipedia and PG19 prefixes.

answer_2.quote: We use MAUVE as our primary metric for automatic evaluation. We also report recall@1 for retrieval and rep/unigram‑overlap statistics.

answer_4.quote: We hired freelancers from Upwork and English teachers/writers as annotators. Annotators were shown a 200‑250 word prefix and two 80‑100 word continuations, asked to choose the better continuation and provide a 1‑3 sentence explanation.
answer_4.guideline: Choose the better continuation in a blind A/B test and explain the choice.
